_note: Bars record what the router ACTUALLY does today, not what we want it to do. maxElectrical (shorts, crossings, open nets) is the bar that matters: it decides whether the board WORKS. maxErrors is mostly fab nits and may legitimately RISE when the ladder buys electrical correctness with clearance violations — that is an improvement, not a regression. Lowering a bar is a deliberate act: do it in the same commit that improves the router, never to make a red suite go green.
